# QR Code generator

Vendored C++ implementation of Nayuki's **QR Code generator library v1.8.0**.

- Upstream: [QR Code generator library](https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library)
- Source: [v1.8.0 C++ implementation](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/cpp)
- License: MIT. The complete license and copyright notice are preserved at the beginning of both source files.

`EQrCodeRenderer` uses the byte-mode encoder for UTF-8 input. The upstream files retain their source layout; trailing whitespace is removed for repository checks.
